series: Chai Ka Chaska, Health Ka Nuskha!
title: Chai Ka Chaska, Health Ka Nuskha!
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, a glossy cute character with big expressive eyes and a small headband, hyper-detailed macro close-up, cinematic soft lighting, rich colours, vertical 9:16

CHAI_BHAI.look: A steaming cup of chai with a friendly, slightly mischievous cartoon face, a tiny red 'tapori' bandana on its rim.

SUGAR_DIDI.look: A cute, sparkling white sugar cube with a sweet, slightly sassy cartoon face, wearing a tiny pink ribbon.

scenes.image: [[CHAI_BHAI]] looking cool and confident, steam rising, cityscape background.
scenes.speaker: CHAI_BHAI
scenes.line: Arre bhai, main hoon tumhari favourite Chai!
scenes.say: अरे भाई, मैं हूँ तुम्हारी फेवरिट चाय!

scenes.image: [[CHAI_BHAI]] looking cool and confident, steam rising, cityscape background.
scenes.speaker: CHAI_BHAI
scenes.line: Subah ho ya shaam, mera hi hai naam!
scenes.say: सुबह हो या शाम, मेरा ही है नाम!

scenes.image: [[CHAI_BHAI]] looking cool and confident, steam rising, cityscape background.
scenes.speaker: CHAI_BHAI
scenes.line: Thoda piyega toh fresh feel karega, bole toh ekdum jhakkaas!
scenes.say: थोड़ा पियेगा तो फ्रेश फील करेगा, बोले तो एकदम झक्कास!

scenes.image: [[CHAI_BHAI]] looking friendly, steam gently wafting, cozy kitchen setting.
scenes.speaker: CHAI_BHAI
scenes.line: Zyada piyega toh lafda ho sakta hai, bhidu!
scenes.say: ज़्यादा पियेगा तो लफड़ा हो सकता है, भिड़ू!

scenes.image: [[CHAI_BHAI]] looking friendly, steam gently wafting, cozy kitchen setting.
scenes.speaker: CHAI_BHAI
scenes.line: Energy milegi par phir neend ka band bajega.
scenes.say: एनर्जी मिलेगी पर फिर नींद का बैंड बजेगा।

scenes.image: [[CHAI_BHAI]] looking friendly, steam gently wafting, cozy kitchen setting.
scenes.speaker: CHAI_BHAI
scenes.line: Moderation mein mast hai, tension nahi lene ka.
scenes.say: मॉडरेशन में मस्त है, टेंशन नहीं लेने का।

scenes.image: [[SUGAR_DIDI]] looking sweet but a bit mischievous, surrounded by tiny sugar crystals, café setting.
scenes.speaker: SUGAR_DIDI
scenes.line: Hi, main hoon Shakkar Didi, chai ki jaan!
scenes.say: हाय, मैं हूँ शक्कर दीदी, चाय की जान!

scenes.image: [[SUGAR_DIDI]] looking sweet but a bit mischievous, surrounded by tiny sugar crystals, café setting.
scenes.speaker: SUGAR_DIDI
scenes.line: Mujhe zyada daalega toh taste badhega, par…
scenes.say: मुझे ज़्यादा डालेगा तो टेस्ट बढ़ेगा, पर…

scenes.image: [[SUGAR_DIDI]] looking sweet but a bit mischievous, surrounded by tiny sugar crystals, café setting.
scenes.speaker: SUGAR_DIDI
scenes.line: Tera BP aur sugar ka level upar jayega, sahi pakde hain!
scenes.say: तेरा बीपी और शुगर का लेवल ऊपर जाएगा, सही पकड़े हैं!

scenes.image: [[SUGAR_DIDI]] looking concerned but helpful, holding a tiny spoon, indicating less.
scenes.speaker: SUGAR_DIDI
scenes.line: Ek chamach kam kar de, kya jaata hai?
scenes.say: एक चम्मच कम कर दे, क्या जाता है?

scenes.image: [[SUGAR_DIDI]] looking concerned but helpful, holding a tiny spoon, indicating less.
scenes.speaker: SUGAR_DIDI
scenes.line: Dheere dheere aadat pad jayegi, bole toh game changer!
scenes.say: धीरे धीरे आदत पड़ जाएगी, बोले तो गेम चेंजर!

scenes.image: [[SUGAR_DIDI]] looking concerned but helpful, holding a tiny spoon, indicating less.
scenes.speaker: SUGAR_DIDI
scenes.line: Kam meetha wali chai bhi ekdum kadak lagti hai, try kar!
scenes.say: कम मीठा वाली चाय भी एकदम कड़क लगती है, ट्राय कर!

scenes.image: [[CHAI_BHAI]] looking a bit serious, with a wise expression, a doctor's clinic in the background.
scenes.speaker: CHAI_BHAI
scenes.line: Agar body mein koi lafda lage toh sidha doctor ke paas jaa!
scenes.say: अगर बॉडी में कोई लफड़ा लगे तो सीधा डॉक्टर के पास जा!

scenes.image: [[CHAI_BHAI]] looking a bit serious, with a wise expression, a doctor's clinic in the background.
scenes.speaker: CHAI_BHAI
scenes.line: Sirf chai pe gyan nahi dene ka, bade kaam ki baat hai.
scenes.say: सिर्फ चाय पे ज्ञान नहीं देने का, बड़े काम की बात है।

scenes.image: [[CHAI_BHAI]] looking a bit serious, with a wise expression, a doctor's clinic in the background.
scenes.speaker: CHAI_BHAI
scenes.line: Healthy rehne ka yahi sabse sahi funda hai, sun meri baat.
scenes.say: हेल्दी रहने का यही सबसे सही फंडा है, सुन मेरी बात।

scenes.image: [[CHAI_BHAI]] winking playfully, holding up one finger for "one", a happy crowd enjoying chai in the background.
scenes.speaker: CHAI_BHAI
scenes.line: Toh bhidu, chai peene ka, par hisaab se.
scenes.say: तो भिड़ू, चाय पीने का, पर हिसाब से।

scenes.image: [[CHAI_BHAI]] winking playfully, holding up one finger for "one", a happy crowd enjoying chai in the background.
scenes.speaker: CHAI_BHAI
scenes.line: Zyada sugar wali chai se thoda dur rehne ka.
scenes.say: ज़्यादा शुगर वाली चाय से थोड़ा दूर रहने का।

scenes.image: [[CHAI_BHAI]] winking playfully, holding up one finger for "one", a happy crowd enjoying chai in the background.
scenes.speaker: CHAI_BHAI
scenes.line: Aap din mein kitni chai peete ho, public?
scenes.say: आप दिन में कितनी चाय पीते हो, पब्लिक?
